scenes.script:
Rahul says: I am giving an English interview tomorrow.
Miss Nova says: Almost, Rahul! Ila cheppandi, I am appearing for an English interview tomorrow. Give ante edhaina chethiki ivvadam.
Rahul says: Ah, got it. Telusa, naa English actually chala better avuthundhi.
Miss Nova says: Very good! Intha baaga matladadam ekkada nerchukuntunnaru?
Rahul says: Mee daggare, Supernova AI app lo! Meere Miss Nova, naa personal AI teacher.
Rahul says: Meeru naku edho random lessons ivvaru, adhi naku chala ishtam. Meeru naa exact level ento telusukoni, naakosam oka personalized plan ready chesharu.
Miss Nova says: And nenu mee mistakes ni eppudu judge cheyanu.
Rahul says: Exactly! Ee crowded train lo kurchoni nenu veyyi mistakes chesina, meeru navvakunda nannu correct chestharu.
Miss Nova says: Endhukante meeru just chadavadam valle kaadhu, actually out loud ga matladi nerchukuntaru.
Rahul says: Avunu. Janalu phone lo feeds scroll chesthu hours waste chestharu, kani nenu mee tho matladadaniki roju ki just 15 minutes spend chesthanu.
Miss Nova says: Correct. Daily practice chesthe, chala mandhi learners ki almost oka month lo visible progress kanipisthundhi.

All brand names, English quoted lines, and numbers remain in their correct English/numeral formats.
